items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who was your teacher, Brother Ray?

ctx.x: No, in some kind of way it gets into your Bronicle II, some kind of way down in there, I don't know. You see, but I was taught never to breathe in an instrument. When you take your breath, I was taught to take my breath from the corner of my mouth. Never take your breath right from the instrument. I always take my breath from the corner of my mouth. I was taught that.
Who was your teacher, Brother Ray? When did you start up?
Oh, Dave Perkins. He's dead, he's been dead now I guess, oh twenty, oh I guess thirty some odd years. Because he died before my mother did.
